mechanical_intent.role: upper arm / shoulder-to-elbow link of an articulated industrial robot arm
mechanical_intent.geometry_intent: Long ~560 mm tapered arm body lofted from a large rounded shoulder housing at the J1 end to a narrower elbow end at J2, with a large oval lightening cutout near the elbow and a cylindrical elbow boss about the +Y joint axis.
surface_features: rounded shoulder housing with bolt pattern
cylindrical elbow boss with bearing seat
rounded fillet transitions between housing and arm

interface_constraints.constraint: Shoulder housing centered at J1 origin; coaxial bore about +Y with bearing seat and bolt pattern on the L1 mating flange face.
Elbow boss centered at x=560 mm; coaxial bore about +Y sized for the J2 bearing/cross-shaft, with flat mating faces for L3 clevis/boss contact.

operations.description: Sketch the rounded shoulder housing cross-section on the YZ plane at the J1 origin: large rounded rectangular outline (~110 mm wide) with generous corner radii.
Extrude the shoulder profile symmetrically about the +Y joint axis (~90 mm thick) to form the main shoulder housing body.
Sketch two guide profiles: shoulder-end section (wide, rounded) and elbow-end section (narrower, ~60% width) on planes at x=0 and x=560 mm respectively.
Loft from the shoulder-end section to the elbow-end section to create the long tapered arm body narrowing toward the elbow, fused to the shoulder housing.
Revolve a circular profile about the +Y axis at x=560 mm to create the cylindrical elbow boss protruding on both sides of the arm body.
Union shoulder housing, lofted arm body, and elbow boss into one solid.
Sketch the large oval slot on the arm side face near the elbow end, oriented along the arm axis.
Cut the oval profile through the arm body to reduce mass near the elbow.
Create the coaxial J2 bore through the elbow boss about +Y with a counterbore/shoulder for the bearing seat.
Create the coaxial J1 bore through the shoulder housing about +Y with bearing seat counterbore.
Pattern bolt holes on the shoulder housing flange face for the L1/J1 interface fasteners.
Apply generous fillets at the shoulder-to-arm and arm-to-elbow-boss junctions and round all outer housing edges.
Chamfer the J1 and J2 bore edges and mating flange faces for assembly lead-in.

prohibited_input_ack: No GT mesh, original CAD, product identity, or hidden labels were used.
